project.name: Kingsford & Perla — Our Wedding
project.objective: Deliver a cinematic wedding-day guest home with a dedicated engagement archive, verified travel guidance, private RSVP and live gift requests.
project.audience: Invited family and friends, primarily on mobile.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Saturated engagement orange, cinematic onyx, champagne metal and deep garnet frame Kingsford and Perla's real photography at editorial scale against warm paper.
creative_system.composition: A single full-viewport engagement hero opens into an editorial invitation, a compact three-frame portal to the dedicated gallery, confirmed wedding-day rhythm, invitation-film interlude, verified Ramada travel guide, live gift centre and decisive photo-backed RSVP stage.
creative_system.motion: A one-time joined-frame hero settle, restrained scroll reveals, layered gallery doorway, pausable six-second Higgsfield film and a dedicated gallery with chapter, mosaic and film-strip modes plus keyboard, swipe and reduced-motion equivalents.
creative_system.sound: Silent web master with no audio track.
creative_system.interface: Persistent RSVP access, large mobile menu, deep-linkable nine-image gallery lightbox, verified travel actions, calendar download, FAQ accordion, live gift reservations and owner-protected RSVP and gift operations.
invariants: 29 August 2026 is always labelled as the engagement date.
Saturday, 19 September 2026 and Ramada by Wyndham St. John's are presented as confirmed.
A real engagement photograph is visible immediately and all nine are accessible on the dedicated gallery route.
The opening motion uses duplicate crops of the same authorised photograph and never synthesises or alters either likeness.
The supplied photographs are cropped and optimised only; likenesses are not altered.
All motion has a pause or reduced-motion equivalent.

screens.title: The Vow Edition cinematic invitation
screens.purpose: Introduce the confirmed wedding day through one immediate real photograph, readable guest actions and an editorial invitation flow.

screens.title: The engagement archive
screens.purpose: Present all nine authorised photographs through chapters, mosaic, film strip and a deep-linkable full-screen cinema lightbox.

screens.title: Verified guest journey
screens.purpose: Give guests the venue address, map, parking, airport taxi, Metrobus, stay and accessibility guidance.

screens.title: Private gift centre
screens.purpose: Let guests reserve keepsakes or privately request verified contribution instructions without publishing payment destinations.

screens.title: RSVP dialog
screens.purpose: Capture or update one household response with a private reference.

screens.title: Protected organiser operations
screens.purpose: Privately review and separately export RSVP and gift information behind owner identity and organiser passcode.

deliverables.title: Responsive cinematic wedding guest home and engagement archive
deliverables.alt_text: Cinematic private wedding home for Kingsford and Perla with a single-photo hero, confirmed wedding day, dedicated all-nine engagement archive, invitation film, verified travel guide, private gift centre, household RSVP and protected organiser operations.
